newsitem.title: USA: Psychemedics sets initial div of $0.02/shr.
newsitem.headline: Psychemedics sets initial div of $0.02/shr.

text.p: Psychemedics Corp Thursday set an initial cash dividend of $0.02 a share, payable on January 30, 1997 to holders of record on Jan. 15, 1997.
The company said it has made no decisions on future dividends, but the matter will be reviewed quarterly.

In a statement, Raymond Kubacki, president and chief executive said, "...Given the company's performance and earnings in 1996, and the fact that it has ample cash to fund ongoing operations, it should distribute a portion of those earnings to its shareholders as a dividend."
